text:
tess (sales): Quick ask from Acme SOC — they need concrete logs/admin trail evidence for vendor risk review. Specifically: SIEM ingest options, retention guarantees, sample admin activity records (user, action, IP, timestamp), and proof of chain-of-custody for exports. Any docs/artifacts we can hand off? cc: @marta @raj

marta (security): Thanks. We can provide: 1) SIEM integration guide (syslog/forwarder & S3 export), 2) retention policy table, 3) anonymized admin activity samples, 4) export audit trail (who exported + signed hashes). Need customer org and retention window they want. :white_check_mark:

raj (solutions): We also have a small redacted log bundle and a prebuilt Kibana dashboard screenshot we can share. For SIEM we support: syslog over TLS, forwarded JSON to S3, and SIEM pull via S3 connectors. Suggest: provide sample with fields: user_id, actor_email, action, resource, ip, user_agent, request_id, ts.

ben (infra): Note: admin actions are logged at INFO with immutable write-to-s3 + KMS envelope. Export process adds SHA256 on the bundle and stores manifest in audit-db. Retention config default 90d for operational logs; enterprise can request 1/3/7 year via contract (extra cost).

tess (sales): Customer asking if we can push logs directly to their Splunk instance. Feasible?

raj (solutions): Yes — either push via syslog forwarder or deliver to their S3 with HMAC credentials. For Splunk HEC we can set up a connector in Dedicated/Private; hosted API customers usually use S3 export + Splunk ingest. We'll need their ingestion endpoint and certs.

marta (security): For the vendor risk packet we'll include: SIG Lite answers, a sample export (redacted), a signed manifest, and our retention SLA clause excerpt. Redaction will remove prompt/response text that contains PII — we'll show sanitized examples. Any PII concerns -> we can provide screenshot instead of raw content.

tess (sales): They also want to know about admin console access logs (who granted roles, who rotated keys). Do we have event IDs for those?

ben (infra): Yep. Event types exist: ROLE_ASSIGN, KEY_ROTATE, ACCESS_GRANT, CONFIG_CHANGE. Sample line:

```
2026-02-11T15:22:07Z | ROLE_ASSIGN | actor=alice@acme.com | target=bob@acme.com | role=admin | request_id=req-abc123 | src_ip=3.4.5.6
```

We can hand over a few redacted entries.

raj (solutions): Suggest we assemble a one-page POC plan: 1) share sample export + manifest, 2) demo Splunk ingest in 30m call, 3) propose retention options + pricing delta, 4) deliver signed evidence pack. I can draft and share.

marta (security): Approve. Also include pointer to KMS key handling docs and our SOC2 cert excerpt. For chain-of-custody we provide manifest + signature + S3 object versioning proof.

tess (sales): Perfect. Timelines? Prospect needs packet by EOD Friday.

raj (solutions): I can assemble samples today. Ben can generate the redacted logs and manifest by 3pm. Marta will attach security excerpts. Can we schedule a 30m demo tomorrow? @acme_contact (not in thread) we can do midday.

ben (infra): On it. I'll drop artifacts to a secure share and paste link (access limited). Will include checksums.

deploy-bot: export-bundle-1789991112 created by ben; url: https://redwood-secure/exports/1789991112 (access: limited, expires in 7 days)

tess (sales): Thanks everyone. I'll update the prospect and book the demo once link ready. :thumbsup:
